name: Post card
summary: One post in a forum or community post stream: an author row (avatar, name, role tag, time), the post body with DS quote and code blocks, and an action bar of text buttons (like, reply, share, more). Ships as a web component, as a class layer (lib/post.css) for a host's own markup, and as a Discourse stylesheet (lib/discourse-post.css) on Discourse's own post classes.
highlights: Web component, class layer, or a Discourse stylesheet
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-post>, plus the same declarations as two stylesheets. The author row is a 40px <aha-avatar>, the name (14/600 ink, a link when author-href is set), the username (14/400 tertiary, only when it differs from the name), a role <aha-tag> (Staff, Moderator) and the time at the end of the row (14/400 tertiary, a link to the post when href is set). The body is 16/1.5 ink, 8px under the author row: the element's own children, slotted, so a host passes its already-sanitised HTML (Discourse's cooked post) and nothing is parsed from an attribute. In the body, paragraphs are 16px apart, links are text-link pink with an underline, a quote block (blockquote, or Discourse's aside.quote with its title) has a 4px border-strong edge on bg-container-secondary in secondary ink, inline code is mono 14px on a grey chip, and a code block is mono 14/1.5 on bg-container-secondary with a 1px border-secondary edge and an 8px radius, scrolling inside its own box. The action bar is <aha-button variant="text" size="sm">: like (a heart with its count), Reply, and icon-only Share and More. The heart is the icon ink at rest and when liked; liked swaps to the filled heart and sets aria-pressed. Each button fires aha-post-action with detail.action; the host owns the like state. Each post has 12px above and below, so two posts sit 24px apart. Three ways in: a page that builds its own stream uses the element; a host that renders its own markup links lib/post.css and adds the aha-post classes; a Discourse theme links lib/discourse-post.css, which applies the same declarations to .topic-post, .topic-meta-data, .names, .post-date, .cooked and nav.post-controls with no template change (the Discourse tab maps each class).
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render. React and Vue pass attributes to the custom element and put the body in as children. lib/post.css and lib/discourse-post.css are generated from the element's own declarations (lib/post-css.js), so the three cannot drift.

props.name: author
props.desc: The poster's display name: the name in the author row and the avatar's initials

props.name: username
props.desc: The poster's handle, shown after the name in tertiary when it differs from it; used as the name when author is absent

props.name: role
props.desc: A role tag after the name (Staff, Moderator, Admin); omit for none

props.name: avatar-src
props.desc: Avatar photo URL; initials of `author` when absent

props.name: author-href
props.desc: Makes the name a link (the poster's profile)

props.name: href
props.desc: The post's own URL: makes the time a link to it

props.name: likes
props.desc: Like count beside the heart; 0 or absent shows the heart alone

props.name: liked
props.desc: The reader has liked the post: the filled heart, aria-pressed="true". Same ink as at rest

props.name: actions
props.desc: Space-separated list of the action buttons to show, in the fixed order like, reply, share, more

props.name: (default slot)
props.desc: The post body. Pass sanitised HTML (a cooked post) as children; quote, code and image rules apply to it

props.name: aha-post-action
props.desc: Bubbling, composed CustomEvent on a button click; detail.action is like, reply, share or more. The element changes no state itself

whenToUse.when: a stream of posts or replies in a forum, community or discussion thread
the host renders its own post markup and cannot swap it for an element
a Discourse theme: it styles core post-stream markup with no template change
one line per topic in a list of topics, not the posts inside one

opinion.note: Keep the like heart in the icon ink at rest (colour rule 6.9); liked is shown by the filled glyph. The More button is an icon-only <aha-button> with aria-haspopup="menu": open the host's own menu from aha-post-action, never a theme-built dots button. Names are 600 and usernames 400, never Bold 700.
opinion.dsv3: EXTENSION — DS V3 has no forum post card. Built from the List and Topic row conventions (40px avatar, name and meta, tertiary time) at reading density, reusing <aha-avatar>, <aha-tag>, <aha-button variant="text"> and registry icons, all on --aha-* tokens.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the rendered element (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe post carries every slot, a quote block and a code block, so name, time, body, quote, code and the action bar all render; the measure also proves a real 40px <aha-avatar> and real <aha-button>s are nested.
